title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast 6000 Breakfast Tea Prefilled Pod & Refill
description: Keep your DOJO BLAST 6000 vaping experience fresh and flavourful with the Breakfast Tea Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. Designed for convenience and ease of use, this pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml e-liquid refill bottle, both filled with 20mg or 10mg nic salt e-liquid. Together, they offer up to 6000 puffs, ensuring you can enjoy extended periods of vaping. The Breakfast Tea flavour delivers the light and aromatic taste of traditional breakfast tea. This flavour combination provides a soothing and satisfying vaping experience, perfect for those who enjoy tea flavours. The DOJO BLAST 6000 Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack is compatible exclusively with the DOJO BLAST 6000 kit from Vaporesso. The COREX2.0 mesh coil technology ensures dense vapour and consistent flavour from the first puff to the last. The transparent pod design allows you to monitor your e-liquid levels, so you'll always know when it's time for a refill.
